name: aurion
description: Customizable HUD editor and combat journal for AION 2.

scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features custom-protocol
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:format && npm run build:frontend && npm run lint:rust
scripts.check: npm run catalog:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:code && npm run lint:format && npm run build && npm run lint:rust && npm run schema:check
scripts.schema: cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features schema --bin aurion-schema && prettier data/schema --write
